Where stories find their rhythm

The studio

Nothing isoriginalanymore.

Unless you’re a little peculiar.

Soho Film House is a British studio that creates and develops animated feature films and series for family audiences.

We start with the heart of a story, lean into our decades of music production, then find the little bit of humour we all need.

If you listen up close on our street, you might hearthat old game, hide-and-seek, being played somewhere near.It’s young Story who counts to a hundred or more,while old Rhythm sneaks off to hide behind our door.So we leave it on the latch every night, every day,just in case those two friends want to come in and play.

An original animated feature
Family · Adventure · Comedy · Musical
